limits: Historical trace configurations, not all current T1 layouts or supported capacity.
World vertices are retained payload, not submitted or visible geometry.
Text runs are not glyph counts.
Unmeasured admission fields must be collected by future production-path count instrumentation before a runtime tier pass.
extraction: Read gzip lines containing vertices panel=; regex (panel|underlay|world|overlay|text_runs)=(\d+); integer min/max over all records. No warm/cold filtering and no timing inference.
